observations: Largest polygons cover broad face, cheek, chin or mouth regions rather than individual crease lines.
Small polygons include under-eye, eye-adjacent and nasal patches; several occur on files named normal_skin and are not a crow's-feet-only taxonomy.
Rectangle-polygon samples cover entire close-up crops and are box supervision, not exact wrinkle masks.
The class mixes facial locations and has no separate crow's-feet label or expression/pose definition.

artifacts.reason: Contains source facial images; only metadata findings are committed.

decision.next: Audit the separately selected Wrinkles Detector / skin-face sources for an explicit crow's-feet definition and localized geometry; do not merge FACE v3 masks into training.
